title: Big Charlie
description: A strange herd of meat-born creatures roaming the night.
body:
The Big Charlie mod brings a terrifying new threat to Minecraft from the Trevor Henderson Universe. From Nuggets to monstrous beings, all are made out of flesh. Lil Nuggets are harmless and can even be eaten which isn't advised. There is also the lamb. A hostile creature that hovers above the ground with his psycic abilities. And at last, there is big charlie himself. A big docile creature that can be used as an food source for infinite food.

## **Updates continue on Curseforge** ##

- A mod made by Zcoper
- Mod created with MCreator!
- Requires Geckolib

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>



► [OLD] What is my console spaming?

Most mobs use special spawning conditions, which means that these mobs can only appear under certain conditions. If the spawning conditions work, this spam is created in the console.

► [OLD] Why are Mobs not spawning?

Spawning Conditions determine which conditions must be met in order to spawn certain mobs. Some mobs only spawn above Y level 60. Some below. Most mobs can only spawn in the overworld than in other dimensions.

► Why are features missing in different versions?

It is recommended to play the newest versions of higher minecraft versions.

Not all features of MCreator available or the same in different versions.
For example: Version 1.19.2 doesn't have the feature of shield, better structure generation or custom villagers, but Version 1.20.1 does have them.

► How can I disable Big Charlie Despawning Mechanic?

Big Charlie Despawning Mechanic can be disabled if you set the gamerule "doBigCharlieDespawn" to false.

► Does the mod work with the Long Horse mod?

Yes! Big Charlie is compatible with the Long Horse mod, but Long Horse won't do anything because there is no need in danger within this mod, the Long Horse could trigger.


</details>



![Big Charlie](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0006f2f1b34a68bdedb3db084b092484fc98d1dd.png)

Big Charlie is a huge creature that looks like a cow without skin. Big Charlie is docile and spawns after five days on the surface. If a player is within 16 blocks, Big Charlie may drop a Lil Nugget. It will also despawn when there is no player within 100 blocks, but this can be turned off with a gamerule. If a player attacks Big Charlie, it will drop raw beef and a Lil Nugget with 10% chance. When attacked, it will regenerate slowly. This mechanic of regenerating after being hurt makes Big Charlie a great opportunity for farming meat.

 

- Config File not inculed.
